title: 感叹：真的太逗了
source_sentence: Can't get over how funny the pandas actually are.
pairs: Can't get over
我一直觉得不可思议，
how funny the pandas actually are.
这些熊猫真的太逗了。
words: 对某事一直感到惊讶、难以相信
note: 口语省略了 I；how 表示“多么”，引出感叹。

title: 补充：只有手机重量的三分之一
source_sentence: It was actually only 42 grams, which is about a third of how much my iPhone weighs.
pairs: It was actually only 42 grams,
它当时其实只有42克，
which is about a third of how much my iPhone weighs.
大约是我这部iPhone重量的三分之一。
words: 有多重；这里说手机的重量
note: which 指前面的42克；how much…weighs 表示有多重。

title: 假设：如果它出生在野外
source_sentence: And if she was in the the wild, she would not have been cared for.
pairs: And if she was in the the wild,
而且如果它当时在野外，
she would not have been cared for.
就不会得到照顾。
note: 原话保留重复的 the；in the wild 表示“在野外”。

title: 假设：要不是这些保护项目
source_sentence: But if it wasn't for all these programs, the giant pandas probably would have gone extinct.
pairs: But if it wasn't for all these programs,
但要不是有这些保护项目，
the giant pandas probably would have gone extinct.
大熊猫很可能早就灭绝了。
words: 已经灭绝；go extinct 的完成形式
note: if it wasn’t for 表示“要不是有……”；后面是假设的结果。

title: 原因：为什么难以放归（1/2）
source_sentence: But it is very hard to reintroduce them to the wild because, obviously, they're very used to being fed here in captivity.
pairs: But it is very hard
不过，这非常困难：
to reintroduce them to the wild
把它们重新放归到野外，
note: 本句下页继续，because 引出原因。

title: 原因：已经习惯被喂食（2/2）
source_sentence: But it is very hard to reintroduce them to the wild because, obviously, they're very used to being fed here in captivity.
pairs: because, obviously,
因为很明显，
they're very used to being fed here in captivity.
它们在这里被圈养，已经很习惯被人喂食。
note: 承接上一页；being fed 表示被动接受喂食。

title: 比较：小得多，却同样可爱
source_sentence: These ones, I think, are a lot smaller, but I think they look equally as fluffy and cute.
pairs: These ones, I think, are a lot smaller,
我觉得这些小熊猫小得多，
but I think they look equally as fluffy and cute.
但我觉得它们看起来同样毛茸茸、同样可爱。
words: 小得多；a lot 加强比较
同样地；这里表达程度相当
note: but 表示转折；两处 I think 均保留。

title: 范围：想去哪里就去哪里
source_sentence: So, the red pandas can literally explore this whole area wherever they want.
pairs: So, the red pandas can literally explore this whole area
所以，小熊猫真的可以在这整片区域活动，
wherever they want.
想去哪里就去哪里。
note: wherever 强调去任何它们想去的地方。

title: 转折：不知道在哪里，但希望能看到
source_sentence: I don't know where we're going to see them, but they hopefully will come out at some point.
pairs: I don't know where we're going to see them,
我不知道我们会在哪里看到它们，
but they hopefully will come out at some point.
不过，希望它们会在某个时候出来。
words: 某个时候；不指定具体时间
note: where 引出不知道的地点；but 转入希望。

title: 比较：关注少，却很可爱
source_sentence: So, red pandas just don't get as much fuss compared to the giant pandas, but they are honestly so cute.
pairs: So, red pandas just don't get as much fuss
小熊猫没有得到那么多关注，
compared to the giant pandas,
和大熊猫相比，
but they are honestly so cute.
不过，它们真的特别可爱。
words: 这里指关注、热情和追捧
note: as much 表示同样多；这里的 fuss 不是责备或争吵。

title: 熊猫谷生词 · 地点与语气
words: 山谷；Panda Valley 是“熊猫谷”。
拐角；around this corner = 前面拐角处。
口语中加强语气：真的、简直。

title: 熊猫谷生词 · 熊猫印象
words: 很棒、太有趣了；这里形容熊猫。

title: 熊猫谷生词 · 野外与圈养
words: 一窝中最小或最弱的幼崽。
野外；in the wild = 在野外。
圈养状态；in captivity = 在圈养环境中。

title: 熊猫谷生词 · 训练与保护
words: 训练；train them up = 训练它们。
giant panda = 大熊猫；giant 意为“巨大的”。

title: 熊猫谷生词 · 放归与生存
words: 重新放归野外；这里指把熊猫放回自然环境。
挨饿、饿死；starve to death = 饿死。

title: 熊猫谷生词 · 外形与关注
words: 这里指关注、追捧；get as much fuss = 得到那么多关注。

title: 熊猫谷生词 · 物种与食物
words: 物种；单数和复数写法相同。
日常饮食、食物构成；这里指熊猫的食谱。
特别的小零食或加餐；这里指熊猫吃的苹果。
